title: In parseKnownActivityEmbeddingCerts of ParsingUtils.java, there is a possible permanent denial of… (CVE-2026-58817)
description: CVE-2026-58817 is a vulnerability in the parseKnownActivityEmbeddingCerts function of ParsingUtils.java that allows a possible permanent denial of service due to improper input validation. Exploitation does not require user interaction or additional privileges and results in a local denial of service condition.
